name: Red Raptor Replacement
summary: Red Raptor Replacement is an exchange offered by Zjolnir at Sen'jin Village in Durotar. It allows seasoned troll riders to trade their original mottled red riding raptor for an updated, armor-clad swift beast.

sections.title: The Raptor Breeders of Sen'jin
sections.body: Sen'jin Village serves as the primary home and training ground for the Darkspear tribe's domesticated raptors. Under the keen eye of handlers like Zjolnir, these aggressive jungle predators are conditioned into dependable battle mounts for the Horde. As riding traditions have developed, handlers began outfitting their swiftest stock with protective saddles, leg wrappings, and reinforced battle gear.

sections.title: A Trade of Claws
sections.body: Zjolnir offers a direct exchange for warriors who acquired older breeding stock. Riders returning with a Mottled Red Raptor can hand over their whistle in return for a mount with freshly sharpened claws and seasoned armor. While the new raptor matches the speed of the veteran beast, its appearance displays the martial readiness expected of the Horde's frontline scouts.

faq.answer: Zjolnir is a Darkspear troll mount trainer and handler stationed in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. He manages the tribe's stable of riding raptors and provides experienced riders with swift mounts.

faq.q: What mount is needed for this exchange?
faq.answer: You need the Whistle of the Mottled Red Raptor, an older breed of swift raptor mount. Zjolnir accepts this mount and replaces it with a newer swift raptor variant.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
faq.answer: The exchange takes place at Sen'jin Village in southern Durotar, where the Darkspear trolls stable and breed their raptors.

faq.q: Is the new raptor faster than the old one?
faq.answer: No. Zjolnir notes that the new raptor is just as fast as the old one, but it features a different look, complete with sharpened claws and reinforced harness gear.

faq.q: Why do the Darkspear trolls ride raptors?
faq.answer: Raptors have lived alongside trolls for generations in the jungles of Azeroth. The Darkspear appreciate the beasts' vicious cunning, agility, and fierce loyalty once broken to the saddle, making them the preferred mount of the tribe.

faq.q: Can members of other Horde races make this exchange?
faq.answer: Any Horde rider who legitimately obtained a Mottled Red Raptor—typically through gaining exalted standing with the Darkspear or being a troll rider—can bring the beast to Zjolnir for replacement.

angles.text: Sen'jin Village is the heart of Darkspear raptor training, where riders prove their mastery over Kalimdor's deadliest predators.
Darkspear raptor handlers supply the Horde with fierce, agile cavalry mounts suited for the rocky barrens and scrubland of Durotar.
